summary_en: FY3/27 full-year dividend guidance raised to ¥90/share from ¥70/share (ordinary ¥80/share + commemorative ¥10/share for 130th anniversary). Interim dividend raised to ¥45/share from ¥35/share (ordinary ¥40 + commemorative ¥5). Net earnings guidance lifted 10.8% on acquisition of wholly owned subsidiary (Shibusawa World Transport) and improved core business utilization; payout ratio floor 50%+.
title_en: Announcement of Revision to Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY3/27
translation_en_brief:
Shibusawa Logistics disclosed on 2026-07-30 a revision to its FY3/27 (fiscal year ending 2027-03-31) dividend guidance. The full-year dividend per share is raised to ¥90 from the prior forecast of ¥70. This comprises ordinary dividend of ¥80/share (an increase of ¥10) and a special commemorative dividend of ¥10/share to mark the company's 130th founding anniversary. The interim (Q2) dividend is similarly raised to ¥45/share (ordinary ¥40 + commemorative ¥5) from ¥35/share.

The revision reflects two drivers: (1) upward revision of net earnings guidance by 10.8% for the full year, driven by the acquisition and full consolidation of Shibusawa World Transport (announced 2026-05-11) and improved operational performance in core logistics (higher throughput, new medical-device services, improved facility utilization, and pricing actions); and (2) company policy to return profits at a minimum 50%+ payout ratio on a progressive basis, with this terminal year of the mid-term plan considered a balanced allocation moment for shareholder distributions.

The company note emphasizes that shareholder returns are a top management priority, balanced against continued growth investment. Forward guidance is subject to standard actualization risks.
